scope.en: Six-page author-hosted paper: abstract, overview, implementation, use cases, limitations. Current public homepage also read. DOI identity corroborated in the Seymour paper bibliography; DOI resolver did not open in this reader. No contemporary backend audit or interactive execution.
scope.sr: Autorski primerak rada od šest strana: sažetak, pregled, implementacija, primeri upotrebe i ograničenja. Pročitana je i sadašnja javna početna stranica. limit.en: The 2013 paper explicitly offers no rigorous evaluation of learning effects; visualization proceeds by line, not every subexpression evaluation. Historical limits are not current specifications. Stepping through a trace does not undo effects in the external world.

limit.en: The vision and examples are not controlled evidence that this interface improves learning. A demonstration video or image does not verify that the interactive prototype works today.
limit.sr: Vizija i primeri nisu kontrolisani dokaz da baš takav interfejs poboljšava učenje. Video ili slika demonstracije ne potvrđuju današnji rad interaktivnog prototipa.

scope.sr: Objašnjenje klase; oba bloka ValueTrackerExample; napomena o updater-u; opisi metoda. Kod primera pročitan je kao tekst, bez renderovanja.

scope.en: Author project-hosted published PDF: abstract, selected passages in sections4–5, selected quantitative methods/results6.1/7.1, Table3, limitations8.3. Public university bibliographic record also read. Not all interviews, references or classroom materials audited.
